questions.title: Trace the recursive calls
questions.question: Without running the program, write the exact output in the correct order. Then explain why some lines appear before the recursive call and others appear after it.
questions.code:
def trace(n):
    if n == 0:
        print("Go!")
        return
    print("Down", n)
    trace(n - 1)
    print("Up", n)

trace(3)
